paragraphs.source_en: “Hmm.” Hideyoshi tilted his head slightly, looking greatly relieved. “Very well, let me think. I shall speak to Nene directly. Nene knows who she is and will certainly not treat her poorly.”

paragraphs.source_en: Uraku said nothing. He had already gained much today. Chacha merely did not wish to enter the capital as a maidservant of the Kita no Mandokoro or as an ordinary attendant. Now he had achieved his purpose. As for Hideyoshi's claim that he would settle the question of Chacha's and Nene's respective positions, Uraku knew that these were merely words.

paragraphs.source_zh: 有乐不语。今日已大有收获。茶茶只是不想以北政所侍女或普通陪侍身份进京。现在他已达到了目的。至于秀吉说要处理茶茶和宁宁的地位之事，他也知那只是说说罢了。

paragraphs.source_en: “Tell her that I shall arrange for her to enter the capital secretly by boat. For now, she is to remain with you. In the meantime, I shall give her situation careful thought. Tell her to take good care of herself.” Hideyoshi threw back his head and laughed heartily.

paragraphs.source_en: Hideyoshi, innately quick-witted and perceptive, could hardly have been so thoroughly deceived by Uraku. And yet, a child was Hideyoshi's one vulnerable spot...
